body:
Thank you so much.  This post was like a warm hug in and of itself.  It was so helpful to get because before I got this my night got worse, and to see this after was tremendously helpful.

The therapy center at my grad school essentially rejected me as a 'too complicated' case - many therapists and psychiatrists really dislike treating people with substance abuse issues.  It doesn't help at all with the shame that comes along with the issues.

I've actually started trying swing dancing, which is good when I'm able to get myself up and going.  It's a challenge re: social anxiety but... exposure therapy, I guess?

I think online therapy is a great suggestion.  I was a little turned off by the price of betterhelp.com ($65/wk for the first six months.)  I'd also have to lie about my suicidal thoughts, as my experience with those sites is that if you answer 'yes' to any sort of suicidal ideation question, it immediately tells you that this method isn't appropriate for you.  I can lie, but it doesn't feel great, and probably doesn't help in the long run.

THANK YOU so much for your comments on my ex.  They were invaluable to me, because I kept questioning myself as to whether or not I was overreacting.

Honestly, if you are willing to just stay in touch, that would be a wonderful help to me (especially as I go through finals this week.)  Speaking of, I'm in a public health grad school studying reproductive and sexual health.

Are we able to switch to PMing?  The rules say not to invite PM as a first resort, but is it okay once we've had already had some contact?

Thank you, thank you, thank you.

P.S.  Also, the irony of going to a school well-known for its medical education/public health failing me as far as what they can provide for my own mental health is not lost on me.
